A '''sonic dampener'''<ref name="MedStarI" /> or '''sound dampener'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was used to protect an individual's hearing from loud noises.<ref name="MedStarI" /> Sonic dampeners were integral parts of a [[sonic dampening helmet]], protecting the wearer while they used [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]] such as the [[Sd-77 sonic pistol]] or [[Sg-82 sonic rifle]]. The [[MobileMortar-3]]'s [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] was fitted with dampeners to muffle the noise of the firing blast.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Sonic dampeners also took the form of devices that could be placed into an individual's ear to deaden the sound around them. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Den Dhur]] wore sonic dampeners, along with [[polarized droptacs]], to protect his sensitive hearing.<ref name="MedStarI" />
